other_conditions: The applicant must be the legal heir or dependent family member of a deceased construction worker registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB).
The deceased worker must have held an active regular membership with MPBOCWWB at the time of death.
The deceased worker must have possessed a valid identity card at the time of death.
The application must be submitted within 6 months of the accident or death.
The application must be submitted at the appropriate Public Service Center/District Panchayat/Urban Body Office as per the applicant’s location.
benefits_summary: Provides funeral assistance of ₹6,000 and ex‑gratia payments ranging from ₹1,00,000 to ₹4,00,000 depending on the cause of death or disability.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
